items.claim: [r56-1] stories reading deleted CSS classes, carried
items.note: (no longer applies). `stories.classes.test.ts` now checks every class the stories read, and it passes.

items.claim: [r56-2] held bar's menu button still opens its menu, carried
items.note: (no longer applies). `ButtonTooltip` marks the button `aria-disabled`, and a probe of pointer, click, Enter and ArrowDown under `<Disabled when reason>` opened no menu. The existing test covers the no-reason case.

items.claim: [r56-3] wrapped bar's drag-reorder picks its gap by x alone, carried
[r56-4] curved bar drops `fit`, carried
items.note: on top of 6a0d910d23, which adds an `overflows` option to `useFitScope`. A curved bar's items lie along the run rather than inside its box.

items.claim: [r56-6] useMenuLeast near-zero minimum under right-to-left, carried
items.note: (no longer applies). `measure` takes the min and max of the button's and the lead's edges, and the RTL test passes.

items.claim: [r56-7] Alt+arrow at an end moves roving focus, carried
items.note: It also covered the last item inside a group.

items.claim: [r56-8] useBarOverflow's size cache keeps every key, carried
Keyless cell keyed by its index after `false`/`null` slots are dropped, so a conditional child remounts the cells after it
A key repeated across arrays or fragments gives two cells one item key
items.note: This needed a behavior call, so I made the strict one and recorded it in `docs/unruled.md`: the first child keeps the key, and the later one is keyed by its place, warns, and is not a reorder unit.

items.claim: Keyed `Bar.Group` is never marked as a reorder unit
Menu-overflow bar doesn't re-measure when its lead appears or leaves
`useMenuLeast` gives a wrong `least` in right-to-left layout
Framed vertical bar doesn't scroll
items.note: Its test is in `Bar.vertical.browser.test.tsx` and is unrun here.

items.claim: `BarMenu` ignores the bar's disabled or read-only hold
items.note: Part of the claim was wrong: `ButtonTooltip` already refused presses in a disabled scope. What was real: `defaultOpen` still opened the menu in a disabled bar, and a read-only bar's flag and choice rows still wrote. Read-only rows now write through a no-op, because leaving `onChange` out drops them from the menu entirely.

items.claim: Disabled compound leaf's popover still opens
`least` shrinks to the lead alone when the first item is a spacer
Bar stories use classes the stylesheet no longer defines
items.note: This is stories only, so it has no changeset. The new `stories.classes.test.ts` checks that every class a story in the folder reads is defined in its stylesheet.

items.claim: Three stories use CSS classes that a 2026-11-14 commit deleted, so they render unstyled
A held bar's menu button still opens its menu, with live rows
On a wrapped bar, a drag-reorder drop on the second line picks its gap by x alone
A curved bar drops `fit`, so its FitLabels never shorten together
A vertical framed bar never scrolls, though its doc says it does
useMenuLeast reports a near-zero minimum width under right-to-left
Alt+arrow at the end of a container moves roving focus instead of doing nothing
useBarOverflow's size cache keeps every key it has ever seen
